theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_crcard_quot_eq_unit
theorems.statement: ∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R], let U := {v : R × R // ∃ x y : R, x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1}; let rel : U → U → Prop := fun v w => ∃ u : Rˣ, (u : R) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : R) * v.1.2 = w.1.2; ∀ v w : U, Quot.mk rel v = Quot.mk rel w ↔ rel v w
